editorial.blurb: Kruthika Spice Kitchen brings authentic Hyderabadi Indian flavors to the South Loop with standout curries and biryanis that keep customers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order through DoorDash for pickup, but call ahead to confirm they're operating that day—some customers have encountered issues with this ghost kitchen setup. Request special preparations (like 'very little oil') when placing your order.
